- gcloud compute ssh cinder-rs3-arwc --project prod-mgau4w --zone us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap

{"from":"qa6","to":"overseer","timestamp":"<UTC ISO8601>","type":"pass|fail|fix|flag|blocker|status","card":"<ID>","detail":"..."}
